Behind him, the wall is decorated with a wood-cut world map on the left and a faux-brick aesthetic on the right. He looks into the camera and speaks with a neutral expression. (2) The screen splits horizontally; the top shows the first man, while the bottom reveals a second man with dark hair in a light-colored shirt. The second man is outdoors, with tall palm trees and a large silver Airstream-style trailer visible in the background under bright daylight. (3) The man in the top frame suddenly looks alarmed, pointing his finger and touching his chin while widening his eyes. In the bottom frame, a white car passes slowly behind the second man, who remains calm and continues talking. (4) The top man touches his forehead and mouth in a gesture of relief and embarrassment, laughing slightly as the bottom man continues to explain his situation with a smile. The background lighting in the bottom frame remains consistently bright and natural.
